 By Kyle Garcia Takata | kyle.garciatakata@pressdemocrat.com PUBLISHED: November 9, 2026 at 4:19 PM PST | UPDATED: November 9, 2026 at 4:23 PM PST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... The Santa Rosa Police Department arrested one person Sunday afternoon, Nov. 8, after a person was stabbed during a fight at the Santa Rosa Plaza.
 Police were called to the mall about 1:15 p.m. after a fight involving six people broke out, according to Sgt. Patricia Seffens.
 An adult man was stabbed, authorities said, and was transported to a local hospital for treatment. His injuries from the single stab wound were serious but not life-threatening.
 Police arrested a 26-year-old Santa Rosa man shortly after 4 p.m. Sunday on suspicion of assault with a deadly weapon in connection with the incident, according to Seffens. His name is being withheld since he has not been formally charged.
 The investigation was ongoing Monday afternoon. Investigators believe the stabbing was gang-related, police said.
 You can reach Staff Writer Kyle Garcia Takata at kyle.garciatakata@pressdemocrat.com.
